oneMove.headline: Prepare the Rome filming sprint
oneMove.detail: One-way TLV → Rome on Wednesday, August 19. Find a private room for five nights near Termini or Monti, keep the protected reserve intact, and prepare four filming days. No booking happens until the exact live total and cancellation terms are visible for your approval.
steps: Private room target: €250–€300 for five nights before city tax.
Planning ceiling: €1,006; protected reserve target: at least €350.
Film early morning and after 17:00 because Rome is forecast around 32–35°C.
After the trip packet is approved: restore the public funnel and connect the remaining dashboard controls.

machineNow: Trip packet prepared. Current public dashboard alias is restored. Exact flight and private-room checkout totals still require a live recheck before approval. No booking, payment, DNS change, or email send occurred.

then.text: Review the private-room Rome decision packet
Restore languyofficial.com to the intended Vercel deployment; DNS/account approval remains required.
After the trip is secured, verify the funnel, course delivery, Brevo connection, and storage/CPU cleanup in that order.

root: You are the CEO: approve high-risk commitments; the system prepares the evidence and next move.
One dashboard is the control center. Every other idea stays in the durable long-game ledger.
